terms.definition: Transverse waves that transfer energy from source to absorber and all travel at the same speed in a vacuum.
terms.examiner: Radio, microwave, infrared, visible, ultraviolet, X-ray, gamma, in order of decreasing wavelength.

terms.definition: A change in direction when a wave crosses a boundary at an angle, because its speed changes.
terms.examiner: Higher tier: explain with a wave front diagram.

terms.definition: Produced by oscillations in electrical circuits; when absorbed they can create an alternating current in a circuit.
terms.examiner: Higher tier. Used for television and radio.

terms.definition: Causes skin to age prematurely and increases the risk of skin cancer.
terms.examiner: X-rays and gamma rays are ionising and can cause mutations and cancer.

terms.definition: Microwaves for satellites and cooking; infrared for heaters, cooking and cameras; visible for fibre optics; UV for energy-efficient lamps and tanning; X and gamma for medical imaging and treatment.
terms.examiner: Higher tier: explain why each type suits its use.
